prompts.idle: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: medieval RTS wizard turnaround sheet. REDESIGN the wizard in this reference to be MUCH SIMPLER and COMPLETELY FACELESS. Exactly FIVE full-body views in ONE horizontal row, five evenly spaced equal-width cells, S front, SE front-right, E right profile, NE rear-right, N back, identical scale, elevated 30-degree orthographic camera. The pointed slightly bent wizard hat and long robe are ONE CONTINUOUS seamless piece of dark charcoal cloth: the tall conical hood flows directly into the shoulders and ankle-length robe, no separate hat brim, collar, shoulder cape, seam or gap. The face opening is a completely pitch-black empty hollow underneath the conical hood; no skin, eyes, nose, mouth, HAIR or BEARD visible from any angle. Very simple smooth cloth, only a few broad folds, plain belt optional but preferably none, plain dark shoes barely visible. Plain wooden staff with ONE small faceted white crystal, no ornamental metal, branches, prongs or intricate details. No spellbook, pouches, jewelry, patterns, embroidery, trim or armor. Readable iconic silhouette of pointed hood seamlessly becoming a robe plus staff. Grayscale figurine rendering with clean simple forms, enough mid-gray highlights on cloth to read against black. Same restrained dark medieval game style, NOT cartoon, not chibi. Calm standing neutral pose. Genuine transparent background, no floor or cast shadow, no text, labels, border, dithering or pixelation. Each complete figure, staff and hat generously padded and isolated in its cell. Landscape sheet.
